Only selected Humanoid motion clips are distributed: Crouch_Idle_Loop,
Crouch_Fwd_Loop, Crawl_Fwd_Loop and the derived Crawl_Idle_Symmetric
(8 authored Human-muscle right-leg curves copied from matching left-leg
channels). The source FBX and Unity Editor extraction code are not shipped.
The game retains existing standing/running clips and fallback behavior.
Unmerged candidate; native Unity pose screenshots and stance validation
govern whether this branch is suitable for production.
